summary_1line: Bhishma explains how a king should fill his treasury: seize wealth from the irreligious or unjust and redistribute it for sacrifice, public good, and righteous rule.

image_candidates.scene_text: A king orders officials to gather the hoarded wealth of impious men and distribute it among priests, soldiers, and sacrificial fires.
Dust placed between two grinding stones becomes finer and finer as scholars debate subtle questions of morality.
